_comment: Presentation-mode patients, chosen with backend/pick_demo.py on 2026-11-13. Tokens are anonymized: first 12 hex of HASH_MD5('carepriority-' || STAY_ID); no raw identifiers are stored.

critical.why: CRITICAL shock alert that fires right after a NORMAL hour. In the 6 h before it, the real 5-minute arterial MAP drifts from about 74 to 61 mmHg while HR climbs from about 77 to 99 bpm (complete 5-minute data, no artifact values, largest step 10 mmHg / 4 bpm). Alert text names 2 abnormal drivers (MAP 61 mmHg, GCS 9) plus recently ordered blood gas and lactate.

medium.why: MEDIUM respiratory alert after 6 NORMAL hours. In the 6 h before it the 5-minute respiratory rate climbs by about 6 /min to 28 /min while SpO2 drifts slightly down; no artifact values. Alert text: RR 28 /min (+3 in 3 h), hemoglobin 7.4 g/dL, recently ordered renal panel and electrolytes.

calm_bed_rule: eICU stays NORMAL in every hour 18-24, MODIFIED_NEWS2 <= 3 at hour 24, >= 70 five-minute HR values and no artifact values in hours 18-24; first 7 by HASH_MD5('calm-' || STAY_ID).
